verses.text: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

segments.text: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

verses.text: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.

segments.text: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.

verses.text: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,

segments.text: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,

verses.text: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

segments.text: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

verses.text: For with one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against You—

segments.text: For with one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against You—

verses.text: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

segments.text: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

verses.text: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.

segments.text: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.

verses.text: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah

verses.text: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,

segments.text: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,

verses.text: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

segments.text: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

segments.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

verses.text: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”

segments.text: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”

verses.text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

segments.text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

verses.text: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

segments.text: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

verses.text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.

segments.text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.

verses.text: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

segments.text: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

verses.text: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.

segments.text: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.

verses.text: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
